title: shikumi.registry
description:
every project a repository composes, as Shikumi's checker accepted them, or every finding that
refused them. serde reads this shape; the rules that span its fields are checked in the
conversion to [`Registry`], so a consumer can only act on a document through them.

catalog.description:
the repository's catalog, or null when it declares none, and when the document carries a
diagnostic.

focus.description: the project a focused composition centres on, or null for the global composition.

projects.description: every composed project, or null when the document carries a diagnostic.

remainder.description:
the global composition's remainder; null in a focused one, and when the document carries a
diagnostic.

AttributePath.description: a nixpkgs attribute path: attribute names, each one Nix takes unquoted, joined by `.`, such as `jdk21` or `nodePackages.prettier`

Catalog.description:
the repository's catalog: the systems its package set is read for, every package a shell or
step may use, and the one overlay's entries.
the serde shape of the vocabulary's [`vocabulary::document_catalog`], whose descriptions its
schema takes.

overrides.description: the one overlay on the pinned nixpkgs, an entry per attribute it replaces or adds

packages.description: every package a shell or step may use, by the name projects pick it with, each its attribute path in the pinned nixpkgs

systems.description: the systems its package set is read for, each one the pinned nixpkgs knows, such as `x86_64-linux`

Code.description:
what kind of rule a finding broke, as a stable name programs can match on. the message says it
for people and is free to change; a code isn't.

description.description: what it does, in a phrase a person reads

Diagnostic.description: one finding, collected rather than thrown, so a document carries every one of them.

help.description: how to fix it, where there's one fix to name.

message.description: what's wrong with the field, as a phrase the path reads before.

path.description:
the field's path inside the declaration or manifest; empty for a finding about the whole
file or composition.

project.description:
the project the finding belongs to; null for one about the manifest as a whole or a
manifest entry whose name isn't an identifier.

EnvValue.description:
an environment variable's value: text as written, or a catalog package's location, which the
toolchain context resolves to a store path the document never carries.

Identifier.description: an identifier: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

Location.description:
where a finding points: a file relative to the repository root, and the position of the
attribute that defined the field, or of the nearest enclosing one that has a position. null
when nothing has one, and the finding is about the file as a whole.

Override.description:
an entry of the catalog's overlay: why it exists and what lets it go. what it builds is
declared and never copied here.

PackageLocation.description:
where in a catalog package a variable points: the package, and a path inside it, or null for
the package itself.

package.description: the catalog package, by catalog name

path.description: a path inside it; null points at the package itself

Position.description: a line and column, both counted from 1 as the evaluator counts them.

Project.description:
a project as the document carries it: the serde shape of the vocabulary's
[`vocabulary::document_project`], whose descriptions its schema takes. each extension
namespace's value is exactly as the repository declared it, and Shikumi gives it no meaning.

commands.description: entry points on the shell's path, by a name unique across the composition

dependsOn.description: listed projects it depends on; a focused composition takes them with it

directory.description: the project's directory, as the manifest lists it

env.description: environment variables its shells and steps get, by name

extensions.description: the repository's own metadata, one namespace per schema its manifest declares

imports.description: toolchains it uses from other projects: each toolchain's name, and the project that defines it, which a focused composition takes with it

packages.description: catalog packages on its shells' path, by catalog name

services.description: long-running workers, by a name unique across the composition

summary.description: what the project is, in one line

toolchains.description: toolchain settings it owns, by a name no other project defines; other projects import them

Related.description: a second place a finding involves, such as the first declaration of a duplicated name.

RelativePath.description: a normalized path relative to the repository root: no leading or trailing slash, no empty, `.` or `..` part

Remainder.description: the scope of every source no project owns: the repository minus these directories.

Restart.description: when the supervisor restarts a service.

Segment.description: one step of a field's path: an attribute name, or a list element's index.

description.description: what it does, in a phrase a person reads

Step.description: a step as the document carries it. its command line is declared and never copied here.

after.description: steps of the same project this one runs after when both run

description.description: what it does, in a phrase a person reads

Toolchain.description:
a toolchain setting, such as the JDK or the Rust toolchain: what it puts on the path and in the
environment of every project that uses it.

description.description: what it does, in a phrase a person reads

env.description: environment variables every project that uses it gets

packages.description: catalog packages on the path of every project that uses it
